overview: The corpus for this packet is empty: the mined index (data/ac-mined/S31PacketWindowProperty.txt) has no hits because the search terms were the MCP name S31PacketWindowProperty and the modern PacketPlayOutWindowProperty, while the 1.8 anticheats that know the packet call it WindowData. A direct grep of the anticheat root confirms the only references are registrations: Artemis maps SERVER_PLAY + 88 to PacketPlayServerWindowData and Negativity lists WINDOW_DATA in its PacketType enum. Neither runs a check on it. Container property updates are server-authoritative display data (furnace burn time, enchant levels, brewing progress) with no client-trust signal, so nothing flags them.
